Usage: sink info [OPTIONS]

  View or edit the config file.

  If edit, it will be opened in the default editor.

  To config the default editor, add the following lines to ~/.bashrc.  Change
  the 'program' to editor name.

  export EDITOR='program'
  export VISUAL='program'

Options:
  -v, --view / -e, --edit  View or edit config file.
  -h, --help               Show this message and exit.
